description: Patch schema for local Chatterbox VC compatibility using the legacy single audio picker.

unmapped_ui_parameters.prompt: FL_ChatterboxVC is speech-to-speech and does not use a text prompt.
unmapped_ui_parameters.audio_length: The VC node preserves generated speech timing from the input audio and exposes no duration control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.exaggeration: The pinned VC node exposes no exaggeration control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.pace: The pinned VC node exposes no cfg_weight/pace control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.temperature: The pinned VC node exposes no temperature control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.target_voice_audio: The existing Chatterbox UI supplies one audio path. The committed compatibility graph wires that path to both input_audio and target_voice; true cross-speaker VC requires a second target voice selector.

output.contract: Return one readable FLAC audio artifact from the local Chatterbox VC node using the legacy single audio input.
